contract: Implementation uses intact RGB sealed/body pairs clipped at runtime to fulfill the illustrated-envelope request. This is an implementation choice, not a user instruction or a claim of source-file alpha.

bodies.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Deliver ONE matching open-envelope BODY / stationary lining sprite, 1536x1024 RGB PNG.
Image 1 is the exact edit target: keep its own envelope outline, dimensions, straight-on orientation, colors, illustrated materials, gold/silver outer border, side-fold ornaments and lower-corner artwork. Preserve the same rectangle around x96..1442 and y105..888. Do not crop, resize, rotate, change perspective or add anything above the rectangle.
Image 2 is ONLY an anatomy/function reference for the existing game's stationary body underlayer. Do NOT copy its pink/blue palette or its stars into Image 1.
Remove the WHOLE upper triangular closing flap, its flap-owned ornament, the entire central seal/jewel/setting/pendant and EVERY ribbon/bow/tail. These pieces move separately from original sealed-image pixels, so none may remain or leave a silhouette-shaped hole/shadow/ghost. Paint a continuous clean lower front envelope surface across their old location.
Show the stationary OPEN BODY beneath: recessed upper mouth/interior, visibly darker than the outer material, running from the original top-left/top-right opening corners toward a lower center near (768,545); the pale/dark side folds and lower front remain in their original positions. This is a deep open pocket/interior, not a replacement lid or an upright flap. Add subtle inward depth and occlusion along the mouth rim. Keep all interior entirely within the original closed rectangular footprint.
Keep the input's lavish anime illustration, crisp outlines and cel highlights. No realistic photograph, hands, writing, additional ornaments, open lid above the body, scenery or new props. RGB is allowed and expected: outside pixels will be removed with runtime CSS clipping, so do not spend changes trying to generate transparency. Return one image only.
Variant gentle-floral: retain the pearl-blush body, mint enamel, bell blossoms and large lower-corner roses in their exact original locations. The recessed open mouth is muted dusty-rose/mauve with a darker rose rim, matching this floral stationery. Remove the flower rosette, heart gem, central leaves attached to that rosette, all central silk tails and upper-flap bell-vine decoration. Preserve stationary lower/side floral decoration.

sourceCoordinates.flapAttachments: Union with the complete variant-specific seal, attached pendant and BOTH ribbon silhouettes from the sealed image. Triangle alone is insufficient; see original geometryReview estimates. Those outlines require parent tracing/actual motion review.

limitations: Outer polygon is an inward-biased measured starting path, not a pixel-perfect matte. It trims approximately 1-4 source pixels of the mixed outer rim; source-color blending with checkerboard cannot be undone by CSS.
Closed/body border lines and ornament details were lightly redrawn by imagegen; approximate alignment is within a few source pixels, not exact image identity.
No browser integrated hover/extraction validation was run. CSS clipping changes presentation only; raw files remain RGB.
